title: Ordinary recovery equation on iterated pullback charts
statement: For scheme morphisms q:Y to X, p:Z to Y and q0:Z to X with p composed with q equal to q0 [def-pc-scheme], an open cover U of X, an index a, modules M,N on U(a), a map psi between their ordinary pullbacks on the direct chart over Z, and a map s between their ordinary pullbacks on the chart over Y, chartOrdinaryMapRecovery means the following equation. Let Uk=U pulled back along q, V=Uk pulled back along p and W=U pulled back along q0. The canonical pullback lift v:V(a) to W(a) has projections V(a) to Z and the composite chart projection V(a) to U(a) [def-pc-fibre-product]. Write d for pullbackComp for v and the direct chart projection, followed by pullbackCongr of its second projection equation and the inverse of pullbackComp for the two successive chart projections. The predicate is d inverse at M composed with the v-pullback of psi composed with d at N equals the chart pullback of s. This is a constructed equation, with no existence assertion or choice of a module map.

def chartOrdinaryMapRecovery
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) (p : Z ⟶ Y) (q₀ : Z ⟶ X)
    (w : p ≫ q = q₀) (U : X.OpenCover.{u}) (a : U.I₀)
    (M N : (U.X a).Modules)
    (ψ : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q₀ a)).obj M ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q₀ a)).obj N)
    (s : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q a)).obj M ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q a)).obj N) : Prop
